request: AI Core PR3 read-only private Unix backend switch preflight; compare real container bindings, mounts, images, resource and current checkout; never start model or touch DebugAI.

bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'AI_CORE_PRIVATE_SWITCH_PREFLIGHT_V3\n'
printf 'DISPATCHER_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/server-core rev-parse HEAD
printf 'AI_CORE_PR_WORKTREE_HEAD='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015 rev-parse HEAD
printf 'PR_WORKTREE_DIRTY_COUNT='; git -C /home/admin1/projects/ai-core/.worktrees/pr3-verification-20261015 status --porcelain | wc -l
for n in ai-core-model-gate ai-coder ai-qwen3 ai-granite ai-ministral; do
  docker inspect --format 'MODEL={{.Name}} STATUS={{.State.Status}} IMAGE={{.Image}} PORTS={{json .HostConfig.PortBindings}} CGROUP={{.HostConfig.CgroupParent}} MOUNTS={{range .Mounts}}{{.Destination}},{{end}} CMD={{json .Config.Cmd}}' "$n" 2>/dev/null || printf 'CONTAINER_MISSING=%s\n' "$n"
done
printf 'ACTIVE_LISTENERS\n'; ss -lnt | grep -E ':(18080|18081|18082|18083|18084|18181|18182|18183|18184) ' || :
printf 'PRIVATE_BUS\n'; docker volume inspect ai-core-backend-bus --format '{{.Name}} {{.Driver}}' || :
printf 'MODEL_GATE_IMAGE\n'; docker image inspect ai-core-model-gate:local --format '{{.Id}}' || :
printf 'BACKEND_IMAGE\n'; docker image inspect ghcr.io/ggml-org/llama.cpp:server --format '{{.Id}}' || :

chat_decision_checkpoint.source_evidence: ai-core PR #3 at 75778b66, clean existing worktree and four stopped backends confirmed Issue #1 comment 6222440936; new UDS production switch not completed. DebugAI PR #115 separate writer, no duplicate inference.
